sloka: समुत्सृज्य तु सा गर्भं विद्युत्केशरतार्थिनी ।रेमे तु सार्धं पतिना विस्मृत्य सुतमात्मजम् ।। ७.४.२५ ॥
transliteration: samutsṛjya tu sā garbhaṁ vidyutkeśaratārthinī ।reme tu sārdhaṁ patinā vismṛtya sutamātmajam ।। 7.4.25 ॥

translations.english: Having abandoned her offspring, she, desiring union with Vidyutkesha, then enjoyed herself with her husband, completely forgetting her own son.
